title: Use a bounded network budget for postmerge fetch
acceptance_criteria: Only postmerge git fetch origin main receives a fixed 60-second network timeout; local Git checks retain the default ten seconds
Foreign origin, timeout and nonzero fetch fail before source polling, independent review or publication
Fresh origin/main validation, exact-commit ancestry, same-run/attempt three-platform proofs, independent reviewer and publisher remain unchanged
README, AGENTS and worker instructions describe the bound and preserve historical recovery evidence without claiming hard process-tree or night readiness
Independent stage and exact-head/base PR acceptance, green CI and independent exact-main review precede automatic verified Issue63 closure
